summary: Diageo plc filed a Form 6-K (the US equivalent of a UK regulatory announcement under UKLR 6.4.6R) on 5 November 2026 disclosing a routine board committee succession: non-executive director Melissa Bethell replaces Susan Kilsby as Chair of the Remuneration Committee effective 6 November 2026. Kilsby remains on the Board as Senior Independent Director and a member of the Audit, Nomination and Remuneration Committees. No financial terms, advisors, shareholder stakes, regulatory clocks or transaction mechanics are involved; this is governance housekeeping rather than a special situation, with no risk-arb angle to monitor.
